name: Hunting A Wraith
source:
A short story from the universe of Dactylion, following an assassin sent on a hunt...but it turns out the target is more interesting than anticipated.

You play as a Hunter, sent to eliminate a certain someone only known to you as the Draemor's Wraith. How the night will develop is dependent on your choices.
translation:
这是一个来自Dactylion宇宙的短篇故事，讲述一名刺客被派去狩猎……但事实证明，目标比预期的更有趣。

你扮演一名猎人，被派去消灭一个只有你所知的德拉莫幽灵。夜晚将如何发展取决于你的选择。
